title: Summer Festival Brings FREE Shakespeare to Griffith Park
description:
Experience one of Los Angeles' summer traditions at the Griffith Park Free Shakespeare Festival, presented by Independent Shakespeare Co. Now in its 23rd season, the festival brings world-class Shakespeare to Griffith Park—completely free and open to everyone.

This video takes you behind the scenes of Coriolanus, featuring insights from the cast and creative team on why Shakespeare's 400-year-old works remain as relevant today as ever.

With an immersive, up-close performance style, the festival makes Shakespeare accessible and engaging for modern audiences. Whether you're a lifelong fan or experiencing your first Shakespeare play, the Griffith Park Free Shakespeare Festival offers an unforgettable evening under the stars. Bring a blanket, pack a picnic, and enjoy free professional theater in one of Los Angeles' most beautiful settings.

Learn more about the Griffith Park Free Shakespeare Festival, performance dates, and upcoming productions, including The Comedy of Errors, at https://indieshakes.org/.
